meta.source: CSS Color Module Level 4, examples in § 14.1.1, § 14.1.3 and § 14.2 (gamut mapping)
meta.license: W3C Software and Document License (examples transcribed from the specification text)
meta.notes: The § 14.2 examples say 'such as': they are illustrative results of the algorithm, printed with 3 decimals. The § 14.1.3 example is a chroma-reduction run whose search precision is not stated.

tolerance.rationale: The examples are printed with 3 to 5 decimal places (rounding error ≤ 5e-4); the binary searches stop at ε = 1e-4 in OKLCh chroma, which moves the RGB result by about 1e-4 per channel.
